about_the_game: You are a brave firefighter in a magic balloon equipped with a powerful water cannon! The world is in chaos — forests, cities, and even clouds are on fire, and the evil flying saws (yes, they're flying now!) They're stopping you from saving the planet. Your mission is to put out fires, rescue animals and residents, but be careful: the saws destroy your ball — dodge or shoot them down with water volleys! Fiery whirlwinds — if you get into them, you'll catch fire yourself!
